simple.meaning: פָּקַח (pâqach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 21 times across Genesis, 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 3:5. Its contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּקַח (H6491).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant
definitions.full: H6491. paqach מָּקַח verb open eyes and (once) ears (Late Hebrew id., open (and remove) rubbish heap, followed by עַל look to, attend to ; Arabic blossom , II. open eyes ; Jewish-Aramaic מְּקַח open eyes, etc.; Syriac blossom ; — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳פ Job 27:19 ; 2 masculine singular מָּקַחְתָּ 14:3 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּפְקַח Gen 21:19 +; 1 singular אֶפְקַח Zech 12:4 ; Imperative masculine singular מְּקַח 2Kin 6:17 +, so Dan 9:18 Qr (Kt פקחה ); Infinitive absolute מָּקוֺחַ Isa 42:20 ; construct לִפְקֹחַ 42:7 ; Participle active מֹּקֵחַ Psa 146:8 ; passive feminine plural מְּקֻחוֺת Jer 32:19 ; — 1 open eyes: a. one's own 2Kin 4:35 ; Job 27:19 ; Prov 20:13 ; 2Kin 19:16 = Isa 37:17 ; Dan 9:18 ; + עַל Jer 32:19 ; Zech 12:4 ; Job 14:3 . b. eyes of others Gen 21:19 ; 2Kin 6:17 (twice in verse); 6:20 (twice in verse); Isa 42:7 ; Psa 146:8 ; — for details see עַיִן 1j. 2. open ears = hear Isa 42:20 (without understanding; figurative of Israel). Niph`al Perfect 3plural consecutive וְנִפְקְחוּ Gen 3:5 ; Imperfect 3feminine plural תִּמָּקַחְנָה Isa 35:5 , ׳וַתּ Gen 3:7 ; — be opened , of eyes; figurative, so as to know good and evil 3:5 , 7 ; opposed to blindness (figurative) Isa 35:5 .
